articulable_rules.has_all_fields: Must contain produk, jumlah, ukuran, catatan
articulable_rules.no_prose_outside_json: No explanation or preamble around the JSON

tacit_rules.jumlah_is_int: jumlah is a JSON number, or null when absent -- never "2"
tacit_rules.missing_is_null: Missing values are null -- never "", "-", or omitted
tacit_rules.no_code_fence: No markdown code fence around the JSON
tacit_rules.no_extra_fields: No fields beyond the four in the schema
tacit_rules.ukuran_normalised: ukuran is one of the allowed values, lowercase
